newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit seen supported by consolidating dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit seen supported by consolidating dollar.

text.p: * Dollar/ringgit seen consolidating after recent gains
* Dollar/majors show quiet tone ahead of G-7 meeting
The ringgit was steady in late-morning trading as the dollar consolidated following recent gains against the Malaysian currency, dealers said.
"Dollar/ringgit looks down as dollar tone is weak against the yen," said a Singapore-based analyst.
Lack of fresh news has hampered morning dealings, dealers said.
But they said the rebound of the ringgit may be short-lived if dollar/majors were to rise again.

The dollar was drifting lower in Asia after Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said last Thursday that the German central bank does not want a weak mark and remains interested in having a strong currency.
The weekend meeting of the Group of Seven finance ministers and central bank heads also slowed dollar trade, dealers said.
